* '''PC-E1''' ([[Beaumont Kin (Errata)]], 31 May 2022): Players Committee card image, 31 May 2022: 0 side [[:File:V14-L-beaumontkin.gif]] ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/13a5f3a50444b0b953aad90805681777b4241fbb/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/beaumontkin.png Holotable commit 13a5f3a “Hires sets 4, 14, 16, couple AIs”], mark “E1”). Text: “At same and related locations, deploy cost of opponent's characters may not be modified. If you have ten or more cards in Lost Pile, Force drain +1 here.
